capabilities: classify tags from note title, frontmatter, content, or selection
insert tags as #tags, WikiLinks, frontmatter keys, or title suffixes
restrict LLM tag choices with filtered or manual reference tags
customize prompts, chat roles, and output prefix/suffix
test and configure OpenAI-compatible or Jina AI endpoints
extras: Support for local OpenAI-compatible APIs (Ollama, LocalAI) is explicitly marked experimental with no stability guarantee; Jina AI has a free tier with 10M tokens and often no account creation needed.
problem: Manually tagging notes takes time, and Obsidian has no built-in way to classify notes automatically from their content.

relations.evidence: OpenAI-compatible API: Uses OpenAI API, Local AI (Ollama, LocalAI), or other compatible APIs
Jina AI: Uses Jina AI Classifier (cost-effective, multilingual)

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API key or Jina AI API key
Ollama or LocalAI for local AI

summary: AI-powered tag classifier that analyzes a note's title, frontmatter, content, or selection and inserts suggested tags via OpenAI-compatible APIs or Jina AI.
